entities.name: Artūrs Bērziņš

entities.summary: Artūrs Bērziņš is a Latvian former basketball player, who plays the power forward position. For the 2017–2018 season he is signed with the BK Ventspils of the Latvian Basketball League. He is now youth basketball coach and an assistant coach for BK Ogre.
